info.name: Maya Zeaiter - Services 1-3 (Users, Assets, Incidents)
info.description:
Sprint I - Security Incident Detection and Response Management System.
Developer: Maya Zeaiter.

Run `python seed.py --reset`, start `python app.py`, then run the folders in order (Authentication first: it stores the tokens).

item.name: 0. Authentication (Maya Zeaiter)
Maya Zeaiter - Login as Security Administrator

request.description:
**Developer:** Maya Zeaiter

Successful login. Stores the token in `admin_token`.

item.name: Maya Zeaiter - Login as Security Analyst (Karim)

request.description:
**Developer:** Maya Zeaiter

Stores `analyst_token`.

item.name: Maya Zeaiter - Login as Regular User (by email)

request.description:
**Developer:** Maya Zeaiter

Login with the email instead of the username. Stores `user_token`.

item.name: Maya Zeaiter - Login as Auditor

request.description:
**Developer:** Maya Zeaiter

Stores `auditor_token`.

item.name: Maya Zeaiter - Login FAILED - wrong password

request.description:
**Developer:** Maya Zeaiter

Unsuccessful login: returns 401 and writes a LOGIN_FAILED audit log.

item.name: Maya Zeaiter - Login FAILED - suspended account

request.description:
**Developer:** Maya Zeaiter

Suspended accounts cannot authenticate (403).

item.name: 1. Users and Identity Management (Maya Zeaiter)
Maya Zeaiter - Register Regular User

request.description:
**Developer:** Maya Zeaiter

Public registration. Password is hashed before storage. Stores the new id in `new_user_id`.

item.name: Maya Zeaiter - Register DUPLICATE username

request.description:
**Developer:** Maya Zeaiter

Same username again -> 409 Conflict.

item.name: Maya Zeaiter - Register INVALID input

request.description:
**Developer:** Maya Zeaiter

Invalid email, weak password, invalid role -> 400 with per-field errors.

item.name: Maya Zeaiter - Register MISSING fields

request.description:
**Developer:** Maya Zeaiter

Missing required fields -> 400.

item.name: Maya Zeaiter - Register Analyst WITHOUT admin token

request.description:
**Developer:** Maya Zeaiter

Privileged roles need an admin token -> 403.

item.name: Maya Zeaiter - Register Analyst AS ADMIN

request.description:
**Developer:** Maya Zeaiter

Admin can register any role.

request.description:

item.name: 3. Incident Management (Maya Zeaiter)
Maya Zeaiter - Create Incident - Critical (admin)

request.description:
**Developer:** Maya Zeaiter

Admin reports a Critical incident. Stores id in `incident_id`.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Data exfiltration from customer DB",
  "description": "Large outbound transfer from the customer database to an unknown host at 02:00.",
  "category": "Data Leakage",
  "severity": "Critical",
  "asset_id": 3
}

item.name: Maya Zeaiter - Create Incident - Medium (regular user)

request.description:
**Developer:** Maya Zeaiter

Regular user reports; reporter is taken from the token.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Suspicious password reset email",
  "description": "Received an email asking me to reset my password on an unfamiliar site.",
  "category": "Phishing Attack",
  "severity": "Medium",
  "asset_id": 2
}
